svg.title: Approach C loop for the reference-selection agent
svg.desc: The user provides a reference-image pool and sets goals and limits. The language model selects a subset. A fixed reconstructor returns a point cloud, reference-to-point connectivity and rendered views. The agent reads those outputs, adds or drops references and asks the user when unsure. Once the user approves the final point cloud, a separate held-out evaluation uses the fixed pose estimator to measure accuracy without feeding the scores back to the agent.
svg.text: stop: target met or budget spent
